english:
Casting your Class Ability grants <solar Cure /> x2.

Scoring multiple kills within 3 seconds of each grants one stack of 'Burning Souls' for 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Activation progress on kills by <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File enemies: 34%
• Enemies of the Elite Tier or higher and Players: 50%

Class Ability Healing is enhanced and granted to allies within 15? meters of cast while Burning Souls is active.

Healing granted at 1|2|3 stacks of Burning Souls:
• <solar Cure /> x3
• <solar Cure /> x1 and <solar Restoration /> x1 for 3 seconds
• <solar Cure /> x2 and <solar Restoration /> x1 for 5 seconds

Existing <solar Restoration /> is extended by the corresponding duration. All stacks expire at once. Gaining another stack refreshes the buff duration.

// The source gives the ally healing radius as 15? meters.

source.text:
On Class Ability Usage:
Grants x2 Cure.

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress by scoring multiple Kills within 3 seconds of each: 
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite+ and Guardians = 50%
Grants a stack of Burning Souls for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.
All stacks expire at once. Retriggering Burning Souls refreshes the buff duration.

Burning Souls: Class Ability Usage healing is enhanced and spreads to allies within 15? meters:
x1 = x3 Cure.
x2 = x1 Cure + Restoration x1 for 3 seconds.
 x3 = x2 Cure + Restoration x1 for 5 seconds.
If Restoration is active, then it will extend its duration by the corresponding duration.
